justifications.durability: the guarded behaviour now fires: a prefix naming only non-image Documents is refused by name, and the declared mutation reddens the focused test, so the fix is not a no-op. justifications.evidence: I reproduced the named gate independently at f823bc569 in the reviewed worktree using the shared environment (21 passed, 1 warning, EXIT=0; review-gate-rerun.log). justifications.fit: the changed docstring says 'image Document', the help text now names the real filter, and no plan, stage or ticket label appears in the code, test names, or commit message. Only nit: the fake graph's _validate_focus branch keys off the literal substring "document_type: 'image'" in the cypher, so a future reword of the real query would silently stop exercising the predicate.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the change is the minimum that closes the gap the parent review named: _validate_focus now counts only document_type='image' Documents, which is exactly the predicate every claim and pending check already applies, so a path holding only PDFs is refused instead of passing validation and claiming nothing. Docked one point only because the plan's two requirements are met but the node's own orientation declared an evidence fragment and a figures directory that were never produced.
justifications.reuse: no new abstraction: the fix edits the one existing _validate_focus query, and the whitespace behaviour reuses resolve_focus_items rather than forking a second check. Both new tests reuse the existing DOCUMENTS fixture and stage fixture.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit touches exactly the two files the node declared and nothing else; no dependency, config, plan or unrelated-file change. The declared fragment and figures paths were left unproduced, which is an unused declared path rather than an overreach, exactly as the parent review framed the same omission.
